sentences.text: In 1975, a shift in direction occurred when work in non-communicable diseases was undertaken in areas such as cancer and infant and child health.
In 1984, work in communicable diseases was redefined with the recognition of AIDS.
In 1986, the function of epidemiology was split into communicable and non-communicable diseases.
